findings.explanation: HOL4 specifies only `dest_Refv (Refv v) = v`. Lean returns the same `ARB` for every other constructor. At element type `Bool`, Lean therefore proves that `W8array []` and `Varray []` have equal `dest_Refv` results. The HOL4 equation permits those results to be `true` and `false`, respectively.
findings.repair:
private axiom dest_Refv_unspecified {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α

noncomputable def dest_Refv {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α
  | .Refv v => v
  | s => dest_Refv_unspecified s
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps
open CmlTS

example : dest_Refv (α := Bool) (.W8array []) = dest_Refv (α := Bool) (.Varray []) := rfl

findings.explanation: HOL4 leaves `FV_dec` open on `Dmod`, `Dlocal`, and `Denv`. Lean returns one fixed set, `ARB`, for all three constructors and all their arguments. For example, Lean proves that `Dmod m []` and `Dlocal [] []` have equal free-variable sets for every `m`. The five HOL4 equations permit different sets on those inputs.
findings.repair:
private axiom FV_dec_unspecified : dec → Set (ident modN varN)

noncomputable def FV_dec : dec → Set (ident modN varN)
  | .Dlet _ p e => FV (.Mat e [(p, .Lit ARB)])
  | .Dletrec _ defs => FV (.Letrec defs (.Lit ARB))
  | .Dtype _ _ => ∅
  | .Dtabbrev _ _ _ _ => ∅
  | .Dexn _ _ _ => ∅
  | d => FV_dec_unspecified d
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps
open CmlTS

example (m : modN) : FV_dec (.Dmod m []) = FV_dec (.Dlocal [] []) := rfl
